channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Max Clark Shows Elite Composure in Bizarre Spring Training Moment
item.description: A Detroit Tigers beat writer shares a hilarious and revealing spring training story about top prospect Max Clark calmly dealing with a broken tooth.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Unveil 2 Alternate Uniforms for 2026
item.description: The Detroit Tigers revealed bold orange and navy alternate uniforms for the 2026 season, inspired by 1984 and shaped by fan feedback. Here’s everything to know.

item.title: Top Prospect Kevin McGonigle to Start Detroit Tigers Grapefruit League Opener
item.description: Top prospect Kevin McGonigle will start at shortstop for the Detroit Tigers in their first spring training game, manager A.J. Hinch confirmed.

item.title: Detroit Lions 2026 NFL Draft Big Board: Offensive Tackles
item.description: The Detroit Lions will likely target an offensive tackle early in the 2026 NFL Draft. Here’s a full big board with recent scouting reports on Spencer Fano, Francis Mauigoa, Kadyn Proctor, and more.

item.title: Writer Reveals Detroit Lions ‘Dream’ Offseason Trade Scenario
item.description: A Bleacher Report writer outlines a dream Detroit Lions offseason trade scenario involving Jets EDGE Jermaine Johnson. Here’s why it makes sense—and the risks involved.

item.title: The What-If That Could Have Changed Lions History Forever
item.description: Former Saints LT Terron Armstead reveals that players wanted Dan Campbell to replace Sean Payton in 2019. A stunning what-if moment for the Lions.

item.title: Perfect Fit for Detroit Lions Has MAJOR Injury Concerns
item.description: Iowa OL Gennings Dunker looks like a perfect Detroit Lions fit after the Senior Bowl—but a doctor flags major injury concerns. Full scouting report, fit, and outlook.

item.title: Detroit Lions “Priority 1” Free Agent May Become Available After All
item.description: With Frank Ragnow retired and no elite 2026 draft center available, the Detroit Lions may target Ravens star Tyler Linderbaum as a Priority 1 free agent.

item.title: 5-Time Pro Bowler Does Not Want to Play Aidan Hutchinson Ever Again
item.description: Former Pro Bowl tackle Terron Armstead admits he never wants to face Lions star Aidan Hutchinson again, calling him “an alien.” Full quotes and breakdown.

item.title: Detroit Tigers SS Trey Sweeney Suffers Injury During Spring Training Drills
item.description: Detroit Tigers shortstop Trey Sweeney is dealing with a right shoulder strain. Manager A.J. Hinch explains the plan moving forward during spring training.
